items.title: Can I fund an open source maintainer through GitHub Sponsors now?
items.pt:
Short answer: Yes. You can sponsor an open source maintainer on GitHub Sponsors now if they have a sponsored profile, and they must live in a supported region to receive funds.

Yes. GitHub Sponsors is built for exactly that: paying people and organizations who design, build, and maintain open source projects directly on GitHub. If the maintainer has a sponsored profile, you can sponsor them from your personal account or, where allowed, through an organization account.

The part people get wrong

items.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
items.pt: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual. As coding agents become increasingly capable at bug fixing, can they autonomously perform such migrations? Existing benchmarks cannot answer this question because they evaluate only behavioural correctness, not whether the migration actually occurred. items.title: EG-ARSA: An Expert-Grounded Open Model for Visual Road Safety Auditing in Low-Resource Settings
items.pt: Road traffic injuries remain a major challenge in low- and middle-income countries, where proactive road safety auditing is limited by incomplete crash records, shortages of qualified auditors, and the high cost of large-scale field inspections. items.title: Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness
